doc: CONNECTOR PLACEMENT MATRIX. The authoritative rule for WHERE a connector (dowel/cam/confirmat/Rafix) is machined is ALWAYS in a JOINT - where one panel's EDGE meets another panel's FACE - positioned on the System 32 grid. It is never a floating marker mid-face.
source: Fabricating Cabinets Learner Guide LMFKB3005A p50 (joints & fasteners), p52 (System 32, dowel+cam flush fitting), p54 (carcase = back+base+two ends+two rails), p58 (concealed hinge 35mm cup, 3mm edge, mounting plate to carcase)
Mozaik JointFast 1-8 + PnlFast (joint fastener templates, dedupe guard p133)
eCabinet KD/RTA hardware; Blum 37/32 + 20/32 mounting-place grids

system32_grid.so: THE coordinate system for cabinet interiors. Each vertical panel's internal face has rows of 5mm holes at 32mm centres.
system32_grid.grid_vertical_panel: bored on BOTH internal faces of ends + partitions; visible rows
system32_grid.grid_horizontal_panel: NOT line-bored; horizontal panels receive edge machining (bolt/dowel in their EDGE)

connector_placement_matrix.so: A joint is a BUTT joint: the EDGE of one panel butted against the FACE of another (LMFKB3005A p40). The connector bridges that seam. Who carries the pocket/insert (FACE) vs the dowel/screw (EDGE) depends on the KD fitting group.

joint_definition.butt_joint: edge of panel A against face of panel B (most common in manufactured-board carcases)

kd_fitting_groups.so: Knock-down fittings divided into THREE main groups (p41-42). Each maps to WHERE it is machined.

quick_assembly.components: insert fixed into ONE component + metal dowel drilled into the OTHER
quick_assembly.face_vs_edge: insert in face, dowel in edge

surface.components: two parts fixed directly to the SURFACE

flush.action: fixed into pre-machined holes or rebates
flush.face_vs_edge: dowel+cam : cam pocket in face, dowel in edge

system32_holes_location.so: Rows of 5mm holes at 32mm centres on the INTERNAL FACES OF ALL VERTICAL PANELS ONLY (p42). Housings: drawer runners, catches, hinges, adjustable shelf supports.
system32_holes_location.horizontal_panels: NOT line-bored; machined in their EDGE (dowel/bolt/insert)

joint_definitions.mating: bottom panel edge -> side panel face
top/front rail edge -> side panel face
back stretcher edge -> side panel face

cam_pocket_on_vertical_face.so: On the 32mm pitch, near the mating edge. Standard = 37mm from the panel edge on the 32mm line.

system32_starting_row.so: Datum is commonly 37mm from the top/bottom of the panel, then every 32mm.

board_joint_machining.edge_connector: dowel/bolt is machined into the panel EDGE (not the face)
board_joint_machining.face_connector: cam pocket / Rafix / shelf-support hole is machined into the panel FACE (vertical panels)
board_joint_machining.cross_confirmat: confirmat screws through ONE panel edge into the END of another (unfinished ends), OR edge-to-edge

gola_drawer_bank_production_spec.so: THE production Gola drawer bank pattern. Hardware is placed by a DIRECTION VECTOR, never guessed [x,y,z]. This is the 'sense of direction' the engine must use.

gola.CNC_side_pockets: L-cutout 59mm + C-cutout 73.5mm, 26mm inset depth (single face loop pushed to 18mm)

minifix_joint.cam: D15 x 12.5mm, B=34mm drilling distance (cam at bolt_center + dir*B_DIST)
minifix_joint.bolt: Euro thread O5 x 11mm into vertical face + collar O7.5 x 1.5 at joint + pin O6.5 x 32.5 reaching into cam
minifix_joint.dowel: fluted beech O8 x 30mm placed 32mm away (System 32 pitch)

gola_drawer_bank_production_spec.joint_count: 16x Minifix per 2x600 drawer bank (4 per bottom front/rear + 4 per top stretcher front/rear x 2 bays)

drawer_box.so: real box: 2 sides (15mm) + front + back + bottom (12mm), concealed runners each side

steelfix_minifix.so: Steelfix / Minifix cam-lock. A flush KD fitting: cam housing in the panel FACE, connecting bolt in the mating panel EDGE running horizontally into the cam. (Authoritative dims from demo_ljoint_connections.rb = Hafele 15mm / Hettich Rastex.)

cam.note: D15x12.5mm, B=34mm = distance from joint edge to cam centre; cam bored on the horizontal panel TOP face

edge_bore.note: D8x34mm bolt channel hole in the horizontal panel edge (runs along the joining axis toward cam)

face_bore.note: D5x11.5mm thread hole in the vertical panel face

bolt_model.pin: O6.5 x 26mm (smooth shank reaching into cam, +Y)
bolt_model.head: O6.8 x 6.5mm (spherical locking head in cam)

dowel.note: fluted beech pin D8x30mm; face bore D8x10.5, edge bore D8x21

confirmat.note: D7x50mm countersunk; vert panel D7 + D10 bevel; horiz pilot D5x42

steelfix_minifix.cap: cover cap over the cam pocket face
steelfix_minifix.installation: insert cam housing in face -> drop bolt wall in -> turn cam 90deg to lock

practical_placement_numbers.note: Values per industry-standard KD hardware (confirm with specific manufacturer catalogue for exact bore depths/sizes)

implementation_rule.so: When drawing a connector for a unit, place it at the JOINT SEAM (edge-of-one-panel ∩ face-of-other-panel), on a 32mm grid row - NOT floating mid-face. Tool: resolve the joint, find panel-B face point at (grid row, coupling edge), then draw cam pocket there + bolt/dowel in the mating edge. Always verify against System32/hardware rules - never invent a mid-seam position.
